messages:
From: Ellie Park <procurement@stenthor.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New supplier: Stenthor - legal name + remit address

Hi Rachel,

We just completed the onboarding questionnaire and have uploaded our W-9 and utility bill. A couple of quick asks from your AP team so we can receive POs and invoices cleanly:  

- Confirm the legal entity name you will record in the vendor registry (we use STENTHOR, INC.).
- Which remit address should appear on POs vs invoices if different? We have a payment address and a separate corporate HQ address.
- Please confirm the ERP vendor ID if you want us to reference it on invoices.

I attached the W-9 and proof of address in the portal and copied Dan Morales (our AP lead) on this thread. Happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Best,
Ellie Park
Procurement Manager
Stenthor Inc.
procurement@stenthor.com

Attachments: W9_Stenthor_signed.pdf, Proof_of_address_Stenthor_2026-08-20.pdf

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Ellie Park <procurement@stenthor.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier: Stenthor - legal name + remit address

Thanks Ellie — welcome and thanks for uploading the docs. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Legal name: we will register the vendor as 'Stenthor, Inc.' in the Redwood vendor registry. Please confirm that the capitalization and punctuation in the W-9 reflect your legal filing. If you have a DBA we should capture that as a secondary name.

2) Remit vs PO address: our standard practice is to display the corporate billing (invoice) address on the invoice and the primary shipping/PO address on POs if they differ. For payments we map a single remit address in NetSuite. Please confirm which address in your proof-of-address PDF should be the remit address.

3) ERP mapping: we currently have an open vendor record placeholder (ERP vendor placeholder id: VN-4992) — final NetSuite vendor ID will be assigned after we ingest the W-9 and tax classification. If you'd like your invoices routed to a specific AR email, include that in your reply.

Action items for us (internal): Kim and Karthik, can you review the uploaded proof-of-address and confirm the remit address that we should register? Also tagging finance for payment channel (ACH vs check) preference capture.

Ellie — copying the attachments we saw in the portal into this thread for visibility. If OK, we will kick a portal invite so your billing team can submit future invoices and attach the vendor portal id in PO footers.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Vendor Operations Specialist
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

Quoted: "Attachments: W9_Stenthor_signed.pdf, Proof_of_address_Stenthor_2026-08-20.pdf"

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: recommended remit mapping for Stenthor

Rachel / Karthik — I pulled the proof of address and it shows two addresses: the HQ at 1101 Meridian Ave (billing) and a payments lockbox at 890 Commerce Way. For speed of payments and to avoid PO confusion, I recommend:

- Register legal entity as: "Stenthor, Inc." (matches W-9).
- Set remit address in NetSuite to the lockbox: 890 Commerce Way, Suite 2, Sunnyvale, CA 94086.
- Keep HQ address (1101 Meridian Ave, San Francisco, CA) as the primary legal/contact address that prints on the PO.

Notes: If Stenthor wants ACH payments, confirm the bank details via our secure vendor-portal upload (we should not accept bank info in email). Otherwise, map payments to the lockbox and set invoice routing to ap@stenthor.com.

I will prepare the vendor record payload (CSV) for ingestion and include the PO print fields.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Vendor Data Operations

From: Dan Morales <dan.morales@stenthor.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, Ellie Park <procurement@stenthor.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier: Stenthor - legal name + remit address

Thanks Rachel & Kim — confirmed on our side.

- Legal name: Stenthor, Inc. (exactly as on W-9).
- Remit address for payments: 890 Commerce Way, Suite 2, Sunnyvale, CA 94086 (lockbox).
- Invoice routing: ap@stenthor.com (we will have invoices go there).
- ACH: we'll upload bank details to the vendor portal once you send the secure invite — do not accept ACH details over email.

I'll also attach a CSV with our preferred remit and contact fields for your ingestion. If you could reply with the vendor portal invite link (or vendor id) and the provisional ERP vendor id you mentioned, we'll reference both on our invoice submissions.

Best,
Dan Morales
AP Lead, Stenthor Inc.
